metadata.bill_scope: handling loss dissipates to bath; reverse pathway restores it from bath
metadata.constraint_scope: targets S location changes, including discovery; steering alternatives are actual S events
metadata.device_swap_scope: same material/energy bank; auxiliary capture replaces friction role, not a removal procedure
metadata.discovery_scope: costed physical route to resource pocket, not a learned or shared permanent unlock
metadata.energies: packet2, apparatus1, physical bank energy, device1, trap location -1
metadata.fractional_bank_scope: exact energy ticks; gamma-binomial phenomenological density; common reversible fractional bath
metadata.friction_physics: rejected or redirected attempts spend D fuel; no work reservoir
metadata.gas_scope: unassembled count preparation, not microscopic gas
metadata.sham_physics: driven one-way bank debit (legacy mode name sham)
metadata.sham_scope: same catalytic coefficient, not equal realized fuel or event count
metadata.steering_match: total S state-changing exit rate at the same full physical state only
metadata.thermal_pairs: mass action times exp(-beta delta energy/2)
metadata.transfer_scope: costed direct stored-resource transfer, not population or packet sequestration
metadata.transfer_thermodynamics: all added reactions paired and enabled in dark detailed-balance check
